verdict.rationale: Antigravity's Projects can combine multiple folders and repos into one context, and external documents such as Google Drive links and PDFs appear in a Documents section. That covers building a workspace from docs and repos. Nothing in the evidence shows the workspace can be shared with teammates as a common source of truth; Projects appear to be local, per-user agent boundaries. Missing for 10: team sharing or collaboration on a workspace, multi-user access controls, sync of a common source of truth, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: a project can work with one folder or multiple folders (e.g., a frontend and a backend repo), providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase
Group your conversations into Projects, which can span multiple folders and support custom settings and scoped permissions.
External files such as Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office documents now appear in their own Documents section in the sidebar above Artifacts.
Agents work within Projects, which define the boundaries of the folders and repositories they can access.
